text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, some time after the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono, normally so cheerful,wore a strangely perplexed expression.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, umm... I thought it might just be my imagination, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: My leg feels kind of strange.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the exam results... While it's not quite an injury,
there does appear to be some mild inflammation.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
The strain on her legs from races and training,
along with accumulated fatigue, might be manifesting
as this sense of discomfort.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Continuous fatigue...?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Yes. Hishi Akebono-san's body is exceptionally large. Consequently, she has quite a bit of weight to match.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: The heavier the body weight and the greater the propulsion, the heavier the burden on the legs—especially areas that are harder to support with muscle, like the knees and ankles.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Until now, Hishi Akebono-san's natural physical strength has carried her powerful running. However—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It might be fair to say that her body
is gradually beginning to scream in protest.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono-san's powerful races
that make full use of her physique are truly captivating.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: However, as the workload increases, the physical wear and tear inevitably becomes more severe.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It might affect
the remainder of your racing career.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Please discuss your future plans thoroughly"... huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what should we do, Trainer?
choice_data_list: (That physique is one of her greatest weapons.)
(That physique is one of her greatest weapons)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understood full well that this weapon
could easily become a double-edged sword.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, we did achieve victories by leveraging our strengths.
The path we walked couldn't have been a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's affecting your body,
that means the strain was greater than anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's racing career is on the line.
We cannot let something irreversible happen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: Shall we reset and start over?
Shall we reset and start over?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Starting... fresh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Step away from racing for a while to shed weight.
Then seek out and build a new racing style that eases the strain on the legs."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono listened in silence until the end
as the proposal was haltingly explained.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...
I... as for me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep running like this. Everyone's
waiting for me, and running is just so much fun right now."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Still, but—I guess that's true.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
you're saying these harsh things
for my sake, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
“...... Would it be alright
if I thought about it for a bit~?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Hishi Akebono was gazing, there was a poster
from the recent Yasuda Kinen—perhaps one they missed taking down—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A giant poster featuring Hishi Akebono and Taiki Shuttle
facing off was proudly displayed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What should I make?
For now, let's boil some water~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm.
A me with a different body from now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Now, all eyes are on Hishi Akebono, who has dropped a significant amount of weight since her last race.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
While her signature power seems somewhat muted,
her footwork looks remarkably light in return.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gradually moving up in position,
she is eyeing the lead!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. It really does feel like something I could keep doing forever~.
And I might be able to get even stronger and stronger, too~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's Hishi Akebono?!
Standing next to the other girls, she really is huge~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'm looking forward to the race too!
It's gonna be so intense~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was huge! I mean,
running alongside her has some seriously insane presence, right!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The surprised gasps at my size, the smiles,
the cheersâall of it made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"‘Big Bono-chan and little Biko-chan
both giving it their all and clashing with everything
they had was truly inspiring!’"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Ehehe, the comments make me so happy.
Everyone is cheering for me~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
More and more people started cheering for me,
telling me how much they loved my powerful races—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono and Taiki Shuttle...
A heavyweight clash like that is quite a sight to behold!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Other girls' races are fun too, but
Buono-chan is just something special...
Her power is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: It really cheers me right up~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I think I'd rather stay in my current body for a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Still, but... if I can't run anymore, I won't be able to put on races for everyone, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What should I do~?
What should I do~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll just have rice porridge today~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after discussing future plans with Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Trainer,
about the long vacation?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well... could you wait
just a little bit longer? Like... three—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: About three months.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know... I wanna see everyone's faces
at the Sprinters Stakes before I make up my mind~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I wonder~...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Regardless, I can't force her into something she doesn't agree with.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to keep an eye on things with a routine that was easy on her legs
and wait until Hishi Akebono reached her own answer.
